title: 📜 Patch Notes + Smarter Fits
notes: 📜 NEW: Patch Notes. Read every update and when it shipped (find it at the bottom of My Team).
🧠 Trade Finder fits now match team mode: Rebuilders hold onto picks and youth, Contenders turn picks into help now.
📝 Every suggestion lists the specific reasons it works for each side, plus the fairness bar at a glance.
🔘 Bigger Find buttons so they're easy to spot.
